integrity: Analytic proof from the one-direction symmetry theorem, an irrational-angle reflection-group argument, and an explicit ellipsoid obstruction. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem certifies one explicit d-direction family and proves the universal lower bound d; it does not classify every d-tuple or provide quantitative stability. Unindexed or unpublished priority risk remains.
title: The sharp minimum number of curvature-order directions for spherical rigidity in every dimension
